findingDetails.title: trailer.spec-exists is satisfied by a traversal value (Spec: ..)
findingDetails.evidence: node probe calling validateCommit with a filesystem-backed specExists (shape of worktreeContext, :694) and a message ending in 'Spec: ..' returned REL=['.'] and ERRORS=[]; path.posix.join('specs','..') normalizes to '.'; rangeContext still passes via the disk fallback at :747 (git cat-file -e HEAD:. exits non-zero, so inTree is not the pass path); forbiddenPrefix does not see dot segments.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject '..' segments (or require path.posix.normalize(rel) === rel, excluding '.') and assert containment under the spec root; add a unit case asserting 'Spec: ..' produces trailer.spec-exists.

findingDetails.title: body.breakingSections labels are type-checked but not prefix-checked
findingDetails.evidence: Shape check enforces only a non-empty string[] (:197-199); the rule is literal line.startsWith(label + ':') (:539). A label containing ':' or trailing whitespace never matches a line, so every breaking commit is blocked (fail-closed); an empty label matches any line starting with ':'. Shipped labels Context/Changes/Verification are unaffected; the gap matters for repository-local contract copies.
findingDetails.recommendation: Validate each label at load: non-empty, no leading/trailing whitespace, no ':' or newline (e.g. ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9 -]*$).
